authentication.value: the vCenter session identifier supplied to the client
authentication.notes: Sent on every request. HTTP Basic authentication is not used by this client.

operations.description: Queries the authorization roles in the vCenter Server matching given criteria. Results are paged with an opaque marker cursor.

serialization.note: The FilterSpec object is exploded, so its property appears as a top-level query parameter named after the property.

query_parameters.name: page_size

serialization.note: The IterationSpec object is exploded, so its property appears as a top-level query parameter named after the property.

query_parameters.server_policy: The service may return fewer records than page_size. A short page does NOT indicate the end of the collection.

query_parameters.name: marker

serialization.note: The IterationSpec object is exploded, so its property appears as a top-level query parameter named after the property.

query_parameters.encoding: opaque token echoed verbatim from the previous ListResult.marker; percent-encoded as a query value
query_parameters.notes: Absent on the first request of a collection traversal. Never send it as an empty value.

operations.unset_optional_field_rule: An optional query parameter that has no value MUST be omitted from the query string entirely. Sending the key with an empty value (for example 'marker=' or 'is_system=') is a contract violation and the server rejects it with 400 Vapi.Std.Errors.InvalidArgument.
operations.no_other_query_parameters: Only is_system, page_size and marker may appear. Any other key is rejected with 400 Vapi.Std.Errors.InvalidArgument. A key may not appear more than once.

spec_parameters_not_used_by_this_client.names: array of role names (form/explode) - this client does not filter by name, so the key is never sent
spec_parameters_not_used_by_this_client.privileges: array of privilege IDs (form/explode) - this client does not filter by privilege, so the key is never sent

role.description: The ID of the role (resource type com.vmware.vcenter.authorization.Role).

privileges.note: Set semantics: the order of this array is not significant and must not be relied upon.

marker.description: Opaque cursor to the last returned role. If present, more records remain and it must be passed to the next request. If absent or null, all currently available roles have been returned.

pagination.next_request: set marker to the marker value returned by the immediately preceding response, unchanged
pagination.termination: stop when a response body has no marker property, or its marker is null
must_not: stop because a page returned fewer items than page_size
issue a further request after a response that carried no marker
synthesise, decode, or modify a marker value

report_format.description: Stable rendering of the fully drained roles collection.
report_format.line_terminator: a single LF character (U+000A) after every line, including the last
report_format.privileges_encoding: the privilege strings sorted ascending and joined with a single comma; an empty privilege set renders as an empty field
report_format.row_order: ascending by info.name; ties broken by ascending role. Ordering is by Java String.compareTo (UTF-16 code unit order).
